A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a combination of lexical, prosodic and structural features is the best way to predict what to include in a summary.
lexical, structural and discourse cues are all useful for summarizing speech, but that acoustic/prosodic cues are less useful.

a summarization task is a good testbed for evaluating the usefulness of different features in speech recognition and understanding.
